@b1_cost = 400

building_test = {
	base_buildtime = 360
	category = research
	potential = {
		owner = { is_wilderness_empire = no }
	}
	allow = {
		owner = { has_test_dlc = yes }
	}
	planet_modifier = {
		job_test_add = 200
		planet_stability_add = 2
	}
	triggered_planet_modifier = {
		potential = { owner = { is_gestalt = yes } }
		job_test_swap_add = 100
	}
	resources = {
		category = planet_buildings
		inline_script = {
			script = buildings/cost_switch
			REGULAR_RESOURCE = minerals
			NOMADIC_RESOURCE = exotic_gases
			COST = @b1_cost
		}
		upkeep = { energy = 2 }
	}
	prerequisites = { "tech_test" }
	upgrades = { "building_test_2" }
}

building_test_2 = {
	base_buildtime = 480
	can_build = no
	category = research
	icon = building_test
	resources = {
		cost = { minerals = 600 }
		upkeep = { energy = 4 }
	}
